_comment: Tracked allowlist for the release gate (docs/release-gate.md). knownFailures: pre-existing failing test files, each with the reason; any OTHER failing file fails the gate, and an entry that starts passing must be removed. sandboxIntegrationRoutes: exact route + status the sandbox tolerates because it deliberately has no Replit connectors or KONG access. Adding entries requires the PR label gate-justified.

/api/calendar/sync.reason: Google Calendar goes through the Replit connector (X_REPLIT_TOKEN), which only exists on Replit; the handler answers 500 instead of a clear 503 when the connector is absent (pre-existing).

/api/agents-office/cities.reason: The KONG city directory needs KONG read access, deliberately absent in the sandbox; the route answers an explicit 503.
